_meta.note: Este arquivo é um template. O script scripts/rebuild-counters.js sobrescreve os campos 'counters' e 'finished_at' com valores reais ao final do rebuild. Execute: node scripts/rebuild-counters.js

post_rebuild_validation.note: Execute as queries abaixo com role service_role. Resultado esperado: 0 linhas em cada.

queries.C8_portfolio_likes_count: SELECT pi.id, pi.likes_count AS stored, COUNT(l.id) AS real, pi.likes_count - COUNT(l.id) AS drift FROM public.portfolio_images pi LEFT JOIN public.likes l ON l.content_id = pi.id AND l.content_type = 'portfolio_image' WHERE pi.status != 'deleted' GROUP BY pi.id, pi.likes_count HAVING pi.likes_count IS DISTINCT FROM COUNT(l.id);
queries.C10_stories_views_count: SELECT s.id, s.views_count AS stored, COUNT(sv.id) AS real, s.views_count - COUNT(sv.id) AS drift FROM public.stories s LEFT JOIN public.story_views sv ON sv.story_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.views_count HAVING s.views_count IS DISTINCT FROM COUNT(sv.id);
queries.C11_stories_likes_count: SELECT s.id, s.likes_count AS stored, COUNT(l.id) AS real, s.likes_count - COUNT(l.id) AS drift FROM public.stories s LEFT JOIN public.likes l ON l.content_id = s.id AND l.content_type = 'story' GROUP BY s.id, s.likes_count HAVING s.likes_count IS DISTINCT FROM COUNT(l.id);
queries.C12_feed_items_likes_count: SELECT fi.id, fi.likes_count AS stored, COUNT(l.id) AS real, fi.likes_count - COUNT(l.id) AS drift FROM public.feed_items fi LEFT JOIN public.likes l ON l.content_id = fi.source_id AND l.content_type = fi.source_type GROUP BY fi.id, fi.likes_count HAVING fi.likes_count IS DISTINCT FROM COUNT(l.id);
queries.C1_barbershops_likes_count: SELECT b.id, b.likes_count AS stored, COUNT(bi.id) FILTER (WHERE bi.type = 'like') AS real FROM public.barbershops b LEFT JOIN public.barbershop_interactions bi ON bi.barbershop_id = b.id WHERE b.is_active = true GROUP BY b.id, b.likes_count HAVING b.likes_count IS DISTINCT FROM COUNT(bi.id) FILTER (WHERE bi.type = 'like');
queries.C6_professionals_rating_count: SELECT p.id, p.rating_count AS stored, COUNT(pl.id) AS real FROM public.professionals p LEFT JOIN public.professional_likes pl ON pl.professional_id = p.id WHERE p.is_active = true GROUP BY p.id, p.rating_count HAVING p.rating_count IS DISTINCT FROM COUNT(pl.id);

reconciliation_job.description: Executa reconcile_counters em dry-run — lista drift sem alterar dados. Resultado esperado: 0 linhas.

trigger_verification.description: Confirma que os triggers estão ativos
trigger_verification.sql: SELECT trigger_name, event_manipulation, event_object_table, action_statement FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema = 'public' AND trigger_name IN ('trg_sync_likes_count', 'trg_sync_story_views_count') ORDER BY trigger_name;

weekly_job.schedule: Toda segunda-feira às 03:00 UTC (horário de baixo tráfego)
weekly_job.alert_condition: Qualquer linha retornada com drift != 0 indica bug novo no pipeline de likes/views

monitoring_plan.query_drift_history: SELECT counter_id, COUNT(*) AS total_drifted, SUM(ABS(drift)) AS total_abs_drift, MAX(run_at) AS last_run FROM public.counter_drift_log WHERE corrected = true GROUP BY counter_id ORDER BY total_abs_drift DESC;
monitoring_plan.drift_trend: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', run_at) AS week, counter_id, COUNT(*) AS events FROM public.counter_drift_log GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC;
monitoring_plan.alert_threshold_rationale: 5% escolhido como limiar: 1-2% = ruído aceitável de edge cases, > 5% = bug sistêmico novo (trigger removido, migration mal aplicada, etc.)

counters_not_rebuilt.C14_haircuts_count: Race condition corrigida no código (MensalistaRepository.incrementarCortes). Rebuild manual: UPDATE barbershop_mensalistas bm SET haircuts_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t WHERE t.client_id = bm.client_id AND t.barbershop_id = bm.barbershop_id AND t.status = 'paid' AND t.type = 'revenue' AND t.created_at BETWEEN bm.starts_at AND bm.ends_at). AVISO: transactions é uma estimativa — não é a fonte canônica.
